viewing_check: Count thimbles and check each rim for hallmarks (lion, anchor, Chester/Birmingham, Charles Horner CH, 'Sterling', 925); weigh or estimate the total silver weight; separate plated ones; look for any enamel, gold (9ct), stone-top or named/souvenir thimbles in the boxes and the green cased one; check for dents or worn-through tops.
rate_note: All prices already AUD; no conversion. Local hits: about $30-100 per silver thimble in small lots, $3-4 each in big mixed lots (22 for $70), so a 25-30 piece mostly sterling group sits plausibly $150-300 but resale evidence is still needed.
